passage:
The old lighthouse was no longer needed for navigation because ships used modern systems. The government planned to close it.
Local residents asked to keep it as a museum and weather station. They said the lighthouse had guided fishermen, warned ships, and become a symbol of the coast.
The building was repaired, and visitors could climb to the top.
From there, students saw the sea, harbor, and town together. The guide explained that technology had changed, but the lighthouse still helped people understand maritime history.
A lighthouse does more than shine. It tells a community where it stands in relation to danger, travel, and home.
